title: India - Our Country
parentNote: This unit covers national symbols, festivals, famous places, and basic facts about India. Perfect for building patriotism!
learnBullets: Know our **national symbols** — flag, anthem, bird, animal
learnItFirst:
**1. National Symbols of India**

| Symbol | Name |
|--------|------|
| National Flag 🇮🇳 | Tricolour (Tiranga) — Saffron, White, Green with Ashoka Chakra |
| National Anthem 🎵 | Jana Gana Mana |
| National Song 🎶 | Vande Mataram |
| National Bird 🦚 | Peacock |
| National Animal 🐅 | Tiger |
| National Flower 🌸 | Lotus |
| National Fruit 🥭 | Mango |

**2. Important Facts**

- Capital of India: **New Delhi**
- India's Independence Day: **15th August** (1947)
- Republic Day: **26th January** (1950)
- Gandhi Jayanti: **2nd October** (Mahatma Gandhi's birthday)

**3. Famous Monuments**

- **Taj Mahal** — Agra (built by Shah Jahan)
- **Red Fort** — Delhi
- **Qutub Minar** — Delhi
- **Gateway of India** — Mumbai

questions.content: What is the national bird of India?
questions.why: Peacock is the national bird of India

questions.content: What is the national animal of India?
questions.why: Tiger is the national animal of India

questions.content: What is the capital of India?
questions.why: New Delhi is the capital city of India

questions.content: What is the national flower of India?
questions.why: Lotus is the national flower of India

questions.content: When do we celebrate Independence Day?
questions.why: Independence Day is celebrated on 15th August

questions.content: What are the three colours in our national flag?
questions.why: Indian flag has Saffron (top), White (middle), and Green (bottom)

questions.content: What is the national fruit of India?
questions.why: Mango is the national fruit of India

questions.content: When do we celebrate Republic Day?
questions.why: Republic Day is celebrated on 26th January

questions.content: What is India's national anthem?
questions.why: Jana Gana Mana is India's national anthem, written by Rabindranath Tagore

questions.content: The Taj Mahal is in which city?
questions.why: The Taj Mahal is located in Agra, Uttar Pradesh

questions.content: Who is called the 'Father of the Nation'?
questions.why: Mahatma Gandhi is called the Father of the Nation

questions.content: What is in the centre of the white stripe of our flag?
questions.why: The Ashoka Chakra (wheel) is in the centre of the white stripe

questions.content: Gandhi Jayanti is celebrated on ___.
questions.why: Gandhi Jayanti (Mahatma Gandhi's birthday) is on 2nd October

questions.content: Which festival is called the 'Festival of Lights'?
questions.why: Diwali is called the Festival of Lights — we light diyas and candles

questions.content: Who was the first Prime Minister of India?
questions.why: Jawaharlal Nehru was the first Prime Minister of India

questions.content: Which festival is called the 'Festival of Colours'?
questions.why: Holi is called the Festival of Colours — we play with colours

questions.content: The Red Fort is in which city?
questions.why: The Red Fort (Lal Qila) is in Delhi

questions.content: Children's Day is celebrated on ___.
questions.why: Children's Day is on 14th November — Jawaharlal Nehru's birthday

questions.content: Which is the longest river in India?
questions.why: Ganga (Ganges) is the longest river in India

questions.content: What is India's national song?
questions.why: Vande Mataram is India's national song, written by Bankim Chandra Chatterjee

questions.content: How many spokes are there in the Ashoka Chakra?
questions.why: The Ashoka Chakra has 24 spokes

questions.content: Teachers' Day is celebrated on ___.
questions.why: Teachers' Day is on 5th September — Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan's birthday

questions.content: The Gateway of India is in which city?
questions.why: The Gateway of India is in Mumbai

questions.content: Who built the Taj Mahal?
questions.why: Shah Jahan built the Taj Mahal in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal

questions.content: India got independence in which year?
questions.why: India got independence on 15th August 1947

sections.name: Achiever's Corner
sections.leadingContext: These are higher-order thinking questions about India!

questions.content: Which ocean is to the south of India?
questions.why: The Indian Ocean is to the south of India

questions.content: India has how many states?
questions.why: India has 28 states and 8 union territories

questions.content: Which is the highest mountain peak in India?
questions.why: Kangchenjunga is the highest mountain peak in India (on India-Nepal border). Mt. Everest is entirely in Nepal.

questions.content: Which currency is used in India?
questions.why: The Indian Rupee (₹) is the currency of India

questions.content: Who wrote the national anthem 'Jana Gana Mana'?
questions.why: Rabindranath Tagore wrote the national anthem Jana Gana Mana
